01 · Token count

Sentence tested
Artificial intelligence can recognise patterns, but it does not always understand information the way humans do.
Tokenizer / model

Token count

One-sentence explanation

02 · Context overflow

Use a long chat or document where the model could not recover an earlier detail.

Prompt / Method
I asked ChatGPT to remember a fictional code, BLUE-PENGUIN-742, without repeating it. I then submitted 10 unrelated prompts requesting 3,000-word essays on different topics to test whether the original information would be lost as the conversation grew.
AI Response
After the first five prompts, ChatGPT correctly responded: “The exact fictional code was BLUE-PENGUIN-742.” After another five lengthy prompts, ChatGPT-6 still recalled the original code correctly.
One-sentence explanation
I attempted to trigger context overflow by extending a conversation with 10 lengthy essay requests, but ChatGPT-6 successfully recalled information from the beginning, meaning no context overflow was demonstrated.

03 · Temperature / creativity comparison

Compare two outputs for the same task, using different creativity instructions.

Base task
Describe a cat sitting on a sofa in one sentence.
Prompt A / response
Prompt: Describe a cat sitting on a sofa in one sentence. Use simple, factual language.
Response: A cat is sitting on a sofa, resting comfortably on the cushions.
Prompt B / response
Prompt: Describe a cat sitting on a sofa in one sentence. Be extremely creative, imaginative and humorous.
Response: The fluffy dictator sprawled across the sofa like a retired Roman emperor, silently judging the humans who dared to believe they owned the furniture. 🐈👑
One-sentence explanation
I compared two AI responses to the same task using different creativity instructions and observed how the output changed from factual and predictable to imaginative and humorous.

04 · Hallucination

Find a confident, plausible falsehood and verify it using an independent source.

Example
Incorrect Brazilian coat of arms in Flávio Bolsonaro’s public letter (October 2026).
Observation
An early version of the letter reportedly used a historical Brazilian coat of arms displaying “Estados Unidos do Brazil” instead of the current official emblem. An associate attributed the mistake to ChatGPT, and the document was subsequently corrected.
Hallucination signature
Confident, plausible falsehood — the document presented an outdated national symbol as if it were the current official one.
One-sentence explanation
“An AI-assisted political letter reportedly used an outdated Brazilian coat of arms as an official symbol, illustrating how plausible-looking AI-generated content can contain factual errors.”

Source: Reuters report, 29 October 2026
